verdict.rationale: Hyperbrowser documents a public REST API with an API reference section (fetch-a-web-page), plus Scrape, Crawl and Extract APIs, single-call agent task starts, official SDKs, and programmatic cloud sessions exposed over CDP WebSocket endpoints. An llms.txt also aids AI-native discovery. missing for 10: a published machine-readable OpenAPI/Swagger spec (all probed paths returned 404), evidence on API auth/rate-limit documentation, and independent hands-on corroboration of driving the API end-to-end.
